description: Defines the ApplicationRunParameters class which manages UI components and logic for configuring Android run/debug configurations in an IDE, including activity selection, deployment options, and artifact management.

classes.name: ApplicationRunParameters
classes.description: Manages UI components and logic for Android run configuration settings, including activity selection, deployment options, and artifact management.

methods.name: updateBuildArtifactBeforeRunSetting
methods.description: Updates the build artifact setting before running, enabling or disabling build tasks based on user selection.

methods.name: addOrRemoveMakeTask
methods.description: Adds or removes the 'Make' build step in the run configuration.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the current module selected in the configuration.

methods.name: resetFrom
methods.description: Resets UI components based on the provided AndroidRunConfiguration instance.

methods.name: applyTo
methods.description: Applies UI component values to the AndroidRunConfiguration instance.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the main UI component for this configuration editor.

methods.name: setAnchor
methods.description: Sets the anchor component for UI layout (no-op).

methods.name: createUIComponents
methods.description: Creates custom UI components, including a language-specific text field for activity class input.
